name: Scribe Therapeutics Inc. Common Stock
description: Scribe Therapeutics Inc is a clinical-stage biotechnology company engaged in the development of in vivo CRISPR-based genetic medicines. Its research and development activities focus on cardiovascular and metabolic diseases, including atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). The company's product pipeline includes STX-1150, a CRISPR-based product candidate that utilizes its ELXR epigenetic silencing technology.
